name: Nythran Ascendancy
government: Council where organic minds and AI intelligences hold equal votes. Ideological divisions: Cyber-Symbiotes (fully merged, pro-integration) vs Traditionalists (partially organic, resist total AI dependence).

notes: One of the seven major galactic civilizations; underwent controlled, gradual AI integration so organic minds and AI coexist as equal citizens. Timeline-attested: the Nythran Cyber Uprising (First Civilization Expansion era).

naming_exemption.reason: Civilization name "Nythran Ascendancy" preserved verbatim from the cited Major Civilizations codex and the canonical timeline.
source_refs: canon/L2/timeline/GUMAS_Galactic_Timeline_Detailed_Enhanced.json (First Civilization Expansion era: Velar-Harkon Wars, Nythran Cyber Uprising)

citizenry: Two peoples as equal citizens: Nythran organics AND AI intelligences (co-equal council votes). The polity is not reducible to the Nythran species alone.
peoplehood_note: A STATE, not a people. Its citizenry deliberately spans organic Nythrans and AI persons.
identity_model_note: Polity = a state / political entity, an orthogonal dimension from species (people), culture, and region. A polity does not describe a whole people.

promotion_to_canon.rule: owner directive: promote all staged records that do not conflict with canon
promotion_to_canon.conflict_scan: zero name/office collisions; fabric linter clean; position axis unchanged

formative_event.account_in_prose: A cybernetic revolt against organic rule that nearly caused complete societal collapse, and ultimately produced the hybrid AI-organic civilization.
formative_event.already_recorded: The event is timeline-attested to the First Civilization Expansion era; its substance was not recorded.

tension.issue: Canon describes the transition as "controlled, gradual AI integration". The prose describes a revolt and near-collapse. Both cannot be the plain account of the same transition.
candidate_readings: Sequence — the revolt came first, and the controlled integration is the settlement that followed it.
Perspective — "controlled and gradual" is the Ascendancy's official self-account; the Uprising is what occurred.
Era drift — the two descriptions come from different prose passes and one supersedes the other.
tension.why_not_resolved: No committed record narrates the transition. Choosing a reading would invent the bridge between revolt and settlement.

formative_event.broader_effect: Named alongside the Velar-Harkon Wars as a conflict that shifted territorial control and gave rise to hybrid organic-AI societies.
formative_event.pass: Prose-Claim Ledger Reconciliation — Nythran pair + Union founding, 2026-08-27

education.model: Fully integrated AI-assisted education in which students upload knowledge directly.
education.comparative_note: Source contrasts this with Zyphari apprenticeship-based training and Velar emphasis on philosophy and artistic expression — three distinct civilizational approaches to transmitting knowledge.
education.pass: Prose-Claim Ledger Reconciliation — Nythran pair + Union founding, 2026-08-27

labour_position.context: Recorded within a galactic dispute over automation: pro-labour activists argue corporate automation drives widespread unemployment, and some frontier worlds ban AI-driven labour under organic-only workforce policies.
labour_position.position: The Ascendancy sits at the opposite pole of that dispute by constitution, its AI persons being citizens rather than labour.
labour_position.caveat: The source line naming the Ascendancy's stance is truncated in the ledger; its structural position follows from the recorded co-equal citizenship, and no specific policy is attributed to it.
labour_position.pass: Prose-Claim Ledger Reconciliation — Nythran pair + Union founding, 2026-08-27
